The German Sports University Cologne (DSHS Köln) is searching for a researcher interested in computer vision for human movement analysis with start date April 1. The candidate will work on a collaborative project with PIs Hedda Lausberg (DSHS Köln), Patrick Gebhard (German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence), and Philipp Müller (Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Stuttgart).
